info.title: Agent API
info.description: The conservation.tv agent API, served by the agent itself.

get.description: Whether the agent is up and serving requests.

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

get.description: Each runtime's live status, and whether it has accepted its latest spec. Live, never stored: after a restart it is rebuilt from the runtimes.

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

get.summary: Read the agent's currently defined spec

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

get.summary: List the metric series the agent keeps
get.description: Each series is one metric about one subject, with one unit and set of dimensions, such as the ingest bitrate of one MediaMTX path, and the range of the points the agent still has. A series about the agent’s own device has a null `subjectId`. Optionally of one metric, by name. Read a series’ points with `metrics.get`.

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only series of this metric.

get.summary: Read a metric series over a time range
get.description: The series, and its points from `from` until `to` in buckets of `step` seconds, oldest first: each bucket's least and greatest samples, their mean, the last and how many there were. A bucket with no points is absent, so a gap is a time nothing was sampled. The step defaults to the samples' own, 10 seconds, and is widened so the range has at most 1000 buckets, and returned.

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

parameters.name: seriesId
parameters.description: The series.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Points observed at or after this time.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Points observed before this time; now by default.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Seconds per bucket, at least; widened so the range has at most 1000 buckets.

get.description: Each line the agent logged, newest first: its message with values substituted, the template it was made from, and its values as properties. Page back by passing the last id as `before`.

412.description: The selected operation version is not served

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, newest first.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only lines before this one, by id, to page back.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Only lines at least this severe.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only lines from this logger category or those beneath it, such as `agent.mediamtx`.
